Delete one or more objects by ID.



IDs may be positional args, comma-separated, --ids, and/or --file (YAML array).

Multiple IDs use the same storage BulkDelete path (graph auto-batches).



By default, deletion will fail if the object has dependents (objects that
reference it).

Use --unlink-references to remove this ID from dependents' reference fields
(CASCADE_NULLIFY-style), then delete.

Use --cascade to delete the object and all its dependents recursively.

Do not combine --unlink-references with --cascade.

Core kernel kinds (workstream, criteria, goals, plans, …) refuse hard delete
unless --reason-code is set; prefer archive + aggregate/compress with lineage.

  Delete an object (fails if it has dependents)
  zqk delete BLI-626
  Delete many from a file
  zqk delete --file ids.yaml
  Delete multiple IDs
  zqk delete BLI-001 BLI-002 --ids BLI-003
  Drop references from dependents (nullify refs), then delete
  zqk delete CRIT-002 --unlink-references
  Delete with cascade (deletes object and all dependents)
  zqk delete BLI-626 --cascade
  Dry-run to see what would be deleted
  zqk delete BLI-626 --cascade --dry-run
  Break-glass hard delete of a core kind (requires justification)
  zqk delete WS-010 --reason-code "duplicate fixture WS after migration audit 2026-08-03"

Usage:
  zqk object delete <id> [id...] [flags]

Aliases:
  delete, rm, remove

Flags:
      --cascade                 Delete object and all objects that reference it
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Show what would be done without actually doing it
      --file string             Path to YAML file containing an array of IDs
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ids string              Comma-separated list of object IDs
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --reason-code string      Required for hard-delete of core kernel kinds (min 30 chars); prefer archive+aggregate instead
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
      --unlink-references       Strip this ID from dependents' reference fields, then delete (does not delete dependent objects)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
